Intel: detect multiple imports and function in JavaScript

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using TreeSitterLanguagePack;

var result = TreeSitterLanguagePackConverter.Process("import fs from 'fs';\nimport path from 'path';\n\nfunction process(input) {\n    return input.trim();\n}\n", new ProcessConfig { Language = "javascript" });
Console.WriteLine(result.Language);
Console.WriteLine(result.Structure);
Console.WriteLine(result.Structure[0].Kind);
Console.WriteLine(result.Imports);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metrics.TotalLines);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metrics.ErrorCount);
```
